literal_meaning: অস্থির বা ছটফট করার শব্দানুকরণ (onomatopoeic expression for fidgety movements)
example_sentences_in_bangla: পরীক্ষার সময় সে তিড়বিড় করে উঠল।
example_sentences_in_english: The boy is being very fidgety.
He started fidgeting during the exam.
note: This is an onomatopoeic idiom commonly used in spoken Bengali to describe impatient or uneasy movements.
